entities.name: Martín Lasarte Topolansky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martín Lasarte Topolanski S.D.B. born 12 October 1962, is a Uruguayan Catholic prelate who works as the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Lwena in Angola, since 1 July 2023. Before that, from 17 August 1991 until he was appointed bishop, he was a priest of the Catholic religious Order of the Salesians of Saint John Bosco. He was appointed bishop by Pope Francis. He was consecrated bishop and installed at Luena, Angola on 3 September 2023.
